steps.en: Settled notices are excluded and memo, summons and charge sheet are merged into one PDF
steps.id: Notice settled dikeluarkan dan memo, summons, charge sheet digabung jadi satu PDF
steps.why_en: Only empty data types exist; nothing selects notices or builds the merged PDF.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada tipe data kosong; tidak ada yang menyeleksi notice atau membuat PDF gabungan.

steps.en: OCMS sends the court PDF file to the print and post vendor
steps.id: OCMS mengirim file PDF court ke vendor cetak dan pos
steps.why_en: Only a parking-letter vendor path exists; no court file or court vendor connection.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada jalur vendor surat parking; tidak ada file court atau koneksi vendor court.

steps.en: Court summonses reach defendants to pay or attend
steps.id: Court summons sampai ke defendant untuk membayar atau hadir
steps.why_en: No court summons sending exists; vendor posting cannot be checked here.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengiriman court summons; pengeposan vendor tidak bisa dicek di sini.
